description: Rigid-frame porous materials for the 'porous_layer' element. Every entry states its value, method, physical state, tolerance, status, source and licence. 'status' is one of: measured, datasheet, estimated, unverified. Parameters use the element's unit-suffixed keys; entries with flow resistivity only use a one-parameter model (Miki by default).

AcoustiLab v2 spec, Section 13 (p. 47), attributed there to Allard and Atalla (Propagation of Sound in Porous Media, 2nd ed., Wiley 2009) and to COMSOL's headphone model. The book could not be consulted in this work, so the attribution is not verified. Internal consistency: Johnson's shape factor 8*alpha_inf*eta/(sigma*phi*Lambda^2) = 1.64 and Lambda' > Lambda, both physically admissible.
